# Confirm keyboard draft recovery remains safe after changing views

## What & Why
Draft notices survive navigation between answer and opportunity views. The keyboard boundary should remain protected when users return to a notice after moving through another view.

## Done looks like
- An answer draft activated with Enter or Space at its deadline after view navigation does not open a form.
- An opportunity draft has the same protection.
- The existing no-longer-available announcements remain intact.
